body:
Step 2c of docs/ios-port-design.md. Create :shared (KMP: android target plus iosArm64 and
iosSimulatorArm64) and move the screens, view models, navigation (multiplatform navigation-compose),
theme and the Compose resources into its common source set. Android-only pieces go behind
expect/actual or interfaces implemented in :app: intents and the share sheet, clipboard,
AppFormat (number, date, currency formatting), locale switching, system-bar icons, crash logs,
update download, notification permission. The Robolectric screen tests and the Roborazzi
screenshots move to :shared's Android unit tests and must be unchanged. The iOS targets of
:shared compile on Linux (wired into verify-all.sh) or, if that cannot work, the reason is
documented. No user-visible change on Android.
title: iPhone port step 2c: screens and view models move to a shared multiplatform module
